profile: induced subgraph: For a non-empty set S of nodes of a graph G, the induced subgraph G[S] has vertex set S. Two vertices u and v are adjacent in G[S] if and only if they are adjacent in G. Therefore, the induced subgraph retains exactly the edges of G with both endpoints in S, and includes no other edges.
